test_title: PYST 33: Selection Post (Matric Level) - Quant (Held On 14 Mar 2022 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: A man spends 70% of his income. His income is increased by 28% but expenditure remains as earlier. By what percentage are his savings increased (correct to one decimal place)?
solution:
Given:

A man spends 70% of his income.

His income is increased by 28% but expenditure remains as earlier.

Concept used:

Incremented/Reduced value = Initial value (1 ± change%)

Calculation

Let his income is Rs. 100Q

So, he spends

⇒ 100Q × 70%

⇒ Rs. 70Q

His saving = (100Q - 70Q)

⇒ 30Q

After the increment, his income becomes

⇒ 100Q + 28% of 100Q

⇒ Rs. 128Q

So, his saving

⇒ 128Q - 70Q

⇒ Rs. 58Q

Now, his saving increased by

⇒ {{58Q - 30Q} over 30Q}times 100\%

⇒ {{28Q} over 30Q}times 100\%

⇒ 93.33% ≈ 93.3%

∴ His savings increased by 93.3%.
